# Rounds: The Mental Health Moment with CEO of Talkspace, a UHS Company


UHS_Talkspace_logo


**October 2026** — In this episode of Rounds, Talkspace CEO Jon R. Cohen, MD, sits down with Christina Farr and Stephanie Davis – sharing insights on what joining UHS means for building a full continuum of behavioral healthcare, the early impact of Tee, Talkspace’s AI mental health guide, and more.


[Watch the interview >](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ELKY9Yz-8tc)
